content: Emo baina yero nao auna ge.
Wari be aune buro-mani nuna awong nuna-una baungno atata yero sewa, “Uritira mitoiya amimene nata Tuwa yero nai aune awe mene gitau yao baina yero nariniye?”
Ayero sewa Yesu mene mani maingkoka zo senu bunu nunaeuna towang atu pugairo
eyero sena, “Na meba niye eno sane. Niye dubo kapetegairo mani mamanikakara nao ine oko yero narineya, awiya uritira mokora oko towarineya.
Zo nung dubo nuna puro wosiro mani eyao ine yero nariniya, nung amimene Tuwa Bayau nata Tuwa yero nai aune emo gitau yao baina yariniya.
Arare zo nung na eno nasani mani eyao ine zo kora yariniya, nung amimene na kora yetiya ayao ine yariniya arauwa.
Mani pasenana oko yumanene.

Zo nung mani mamanikaka na tumo didinowa auna zo yumai pasena tamoiye sero, niye bere-bere daba bainakama zo emo auna dube kimegairo wito kurura teugaipu gutero babai teng yariniya. Noeno oko, emo amimene pasena oko yaore oura gutero magayariniya, awiya nona eo yao gege. Arata nung pasena yai aune Tuwa Bayau mene abena pugariniya, awiya nona mou-mesa yao.
Pasenana yumao benaung giti amimene kasa yero emo bauno yumai pasenana zuwarineya. Arata zo nung emo bauno pasenana yumariniya amimene meko yaise.

Arare wawong nina zo meneta te nina zo mene pasena yasese yai giro kapero yangdo. Nao me iwaing pumari kotungno giro wawong dekaongkare gege o te dekaongkare gege nete nao me iwaing topetasa teng yariniya. Arata tere wawongne zere tutupore deka ayero puro nasa ago ning iyao tauyao awao gege awinoiya auna augaya babasa teng oko yariniya.

Ora diti moko nina zo mene pasena yasese yai giro zokero yangdo. Nao me iwaing pumari kotungno giro diti moko dekaongkare gege nete nao me iwaing topetasa teng yariniya. Arata etobe deka ayero puro nasa ago ning kowa iyaore auna augaya babasa teng oko yariniya.
Lama zo tara yao auna ge.
Niye mani-mamani nana zo gaya oko wosao yaise. Awiya susuwa eeno sinena. Angelo nunae uritira atu nowa awong uritira Mama nana auna benaungna kasa nasani mani nunae-una ge ungwe yero nowa.
[Na Emora Mani mene emo tiri-tara yao awiya kau yero tamari sero wosiwang.]

Ora ge zo sana kotungno abena sepu gane. Emo zo lama nuna 100 nunae-una zo mene tara yai giro yangduwarinita? Aung ara. Nung lama 99 nona mininasani miteya awiya doro baung eu ware yero tara yao amaze kau yariniya.
Na meba sana. Nung baungno kau nete taungno aune 99 oko tara yao awong aeno okowata, tara yeti tamiya awiya eno dubo iwaing yariniya ara.
Arare deka aine uritira Maung ninae mene mani-mamani nana nunae-una zo mene Maungna una gomara atu tara yoiye sero sinoiya arauwa.
Otao pasena yai aune kora yaora nagibo.
Otao nina zo mene pasena nina yai giro ning baungno nito nata adungno meko nuna gipe gae. Ayero yasa nung ge nina nigiro kotumao nuna iwaing tamai nupema otao wina-ye yarineyato.
Ora ge nina dai giro doro baungno emo dekaongkata etobe ayao awiya puro nupema tera nuna-una babaya awongto dema susuwa nuna gosinasani ge nito sarineyato awiya nigaeto.
Ora ge ninae teng deka ayero dai giro dubu nana-una benaungna atu keregai gae. Dubura ge deka ayero dai giro niye gaya nung emo meko, diga emota takis pumao emo ine yaise.
Na memoko sane. Niye tawingna etu tairo diyaya giro Tuwa Bayau mene deka ayero uritira atu tairo diyariniya. Ora tawingna etu besaya giro Tuwa Bayau mene deka ayero uritira atu besariniya.
O zo susuuno sana nigipu. Ninae-una etobe mene nona zo eno dubo nunato dekaongka tiyayato dekaongka yai isa sayato giro uritira Mama nana mene isa nunato nigiro auna teng pugariniya.
Noeno oko, emo etobeta etama awong yazo nana-una augaya giro na nunae-una towang atu narinena.” Ayero sena arauwa.
Soumani meko zo mene otao nuna oko ao-diyao yena auna ge.
Yesu mene ge ayero senu Petoro mene atata yero sena, “Tuwa, otao nana zo mene na eno pasena nai na be nazigo ayao awiya pasena nuna yangduwari neni? Be 7 ayao awiya yangduwana teng yarinita?”
Atata yenu Yesu mene abena eyero sena, “Na be 7 ayao yangduwasese oko sinena. Ning be daigairo nibamu 70 taims 7 ayao ine yangdotinasese sinena.
Tuwa Bayau nata Tuwa yero nariniya auna susuwa amaze na emo tuwa zora pugairo sana nigipu. Emo tuwa zo mene mani sou dubu nuna abena nuna abena pugaese ge buro awiya zayena.
Arare ge buro zayero sou mani bunaese senu nunae-una zo abena nuna 10 milion kina amimene emo tuwara una kasa yena.

Nung abena nuna baina awiya pugaine yao teng oko yenu giro emo tuwa mene eyero sena, ‘Emo erita bauno maingne nuna arita wo nuna nona wau nuna awiya apakana emo mene zuma gaero pumaya na moni tamane.’
Ayero senu soumani mene emo tuwara una koing gairo isa sinasani eyero sena, ‘Emo tuwa nana, ning na ao-diyasa abena nina pugarinena.’
Isa senu emo tuwa nung yo-auno giro ao-diro abena nuna baina awiya yangduna.

Ayero yenu nung gare atu wosiro baungno soumani otao nuna zo tauna, nung awiya nuna-una abena nuna 100 kina mitina. Nung amaze taungno dubo iniro dedunasani eyero sena, ‘Abena nana yemeneka keeune mena pugai!’
Ayero yenu otao nuna nuna-una koing gairo nung eno isa sinasani eyero sena, ‘Ning na ao-diyasa abena nina pugarinena.’
Nung eno isa senu ge nuna oko nigao yero baungno senu otao nuna eno eyero sinasani bunao gare pugaiwa, ‘Abena nuna pugairo aung yero aune kasa yarinesa.’
Ayenu otao mani nuna mene giro moko nunae meko yenu baungno emo tuwa eno ge ungwe yewa ara.

Ge ungwe yewa emo tuwa mene nigiro soumani awiya nupema yau senu bunu eyero tugata yena, ‘Ning emo meko nibamu amaze sina. Ning na eno isa sesesa na ning yo-aungno giro abena nana baina awiya ning eno dotena.
Arare na ning ao-diyena ayao ine ning deka otao nina eno yo-aungno ao-diyatesa, awiya teng yatiya.’
Ayero sero dung yero tini kapenu gorobo emora waweng pugairo eyero sena, ‘Niye bunao meko nibamu nung eno pugaipu, nasani aune nung abena nana baina awiya pitiro aung yai aune yangduwarineya.’”
Yesu mene ayero sero ge ewiya susuuno sena, “Arare niye dubo eo-yaore pasena wina-yangduwao oko yao yaya uritira Mama nana mene nona mou-mesa yao deka ayao niye eno yariniya arauwa.”
